requirement: Australia's general ITE safety requirement (AS/NZS 60950.1, product suitable for 230–240Vac/50Hz) is voluntary, but AC power adapters and cord-set components (plugs, cords, connectors) are ‘prescribed’ electrical equipment requiring mandatory certification/EESS registration from an AU/NZ safety authority or a JAS-ANZ accredited certifier. Wireless/radio products need the same RCM Mark, DoC, and compliance folder under the Radiocommunications Compliance Labelling Notice (or the Short Range Devices Rule, shared with New Zealand); cellular (GSM/3G/4G/5G) modules additionally need a NATA or NATA-MRA-accredited test report, with SAR testing required above specific antenna-power/distance thresholds.

Wireless/radio products need the same RCM Mark, DoC, and compliance folder under the Radiocommunications Compliance Labelling Notice (or the Short Range Devices Rule, shared with New Zealand); cellular (GSM/3G/4G/5G) modules additionally need a NATA or NATA-MRA-accredited test report, with SAR testing required above specific antenna-power/distance thresholds.
